hypothesis: As fontes principal e de baixa resolucao podem ser classificadas somente quando a configuracao ONVIF e a evidencia visual estacionaria sustentam o mesmo enquadramento.
outcome: ONVIF profiles and canonical stationary pair are readable. Both configured streams have exact ONVIF-profile bindings and now show distributed visual compatibility in two quiet horizontal pan views. Full equivalence remains unproven for tilt, zoom, and the whole optical range.
